title: Wood Bark
summary: Alchemy ingredient used to make Elixir of Barkskin.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Wood Bark into Salts of Tree Bark and combine with any Suspension to make Elixir of Barkskin.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Blurg, Derryth Bonecloak and other traders. Also carried by some blights and other tree-like creatures.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
